scholarships.description: Scholarship for Nevada foster care youth aging out or aged out of care, pursuing post-high-school education at U.S. institutions. Applicants must apply before age 21.

scholarships.name: Lexa and Marla DaVee Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for Nevada students pursuing healthcare or related sciences, with preference for Hispanic, indigenous, first-generation, rural, and financially needy students. Administered via the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: Phil and Jennifer Satre Medical Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for University of Nevada, Reno medical students in the Post-Baccalaureate Program or rising first-year students committed to practicing medicine in Nevada.

scholarships.name: Jean Bear Mullins Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for Washoe County students accepted to or enrolled in a Physician Assistant or Medical School program. Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: General Fred Michel Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for students interested in aviation careers. Renewable with reapplication; administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: Boston Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for high school seniors or college sophomores and juniors pursuing teaching degrees at Nevada four-year colleges. Administered via the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: Mark and Carol Steingard Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for first-generation high school seniors pursuing business or education degrees at Truckee Meadows Community College or the University of Nevada, Reno.

scholarships.name: Alan Bain Initiative in Math or Science
scholarships.description: Scholarship for grade 9 through 12 students with science or math project achievements. Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: Finchum Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for northern Nevada high school graduates pursuing trade, vocational, community college, or four-year programs, with preference for financial need and non-traditional students.

scholarships.name: Ron and Linda Smith Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: One-time award for Truckee Meadows Community College, Western Nevada College, or Great Basin College students pursuing a degree or certificate. Administered via the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: Nico Goon Compassionate Scholar Award
scholarships.description: Scholarship for northern Nevada high school seniors planning to attend a four-year university. Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: Officer Mike Scofield Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for northern Nevada high school graduates or graduating seniors. Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: John Stockman Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for high school or homeschool graduates from Washoe, Douglas, Carson City, Storey, Lyon, and Churchill counties, and South Lake Tahoe. Administered via the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: Reno Central Rotary Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation of Northern Nevada / Reno Central Rotary
scholarships.description: Scholarship for graduating seniors of Wooster and Hug High Schools in Reno. Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: Mary J. Yamamoto Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for young women high school seniors from Nevada or Michigan pursuing two- or four-year degrees or certificates at accredited institutions.

scholarships.name: GIAR First-Generation Grandmothers Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for first-generation young women from Nevada or Hawaii of Portuguese, Mexican, or Central and South American ancestry. Administered via the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada.

scholarships.name: Nevada Native American Fee Waiver
scholarships.organization: Nevada System of Higher Education / Nevada Department of Native American Affairs
scholarships.description: Waives registration and per-credit fees at NSHE institutions for enrolled members, or direct descendants of members, of federally recognized tribes at least partly located in Nevada. Covers certificate, associate, bachelor, professional, and master programs.

scholarships.name: Edward Arciniega Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for Churchill County High School graduates intending to study a foreign language (four or more years). Administered through the Community Foundation of Northern Nevada scholarship portal.
